title: Barcelona dealt fresh injury setback before Villarreal clash
snippet: La Liga giants Barcelona have late this week announced a fresh setback on the injury front in the club’s first-team ranks. This comes amid confirmation that Andreas Christensen is dealing…
body: La Liga giants Barcelona have late this week announced a fresh setback on the injury front in the club’s first-team ranks. This comes amid confirmation that Andreas Christensen is dealing with yet another minor issue. Defender Christensen only marked his return to the pitch following a long-term spell on the sidelines earlier this month, playing 30 minutes in Barcelona’s victory over Atlético Madrid. The Dane subsequently made the call to pull out of international duty, to focus on ramping up his fitness levels to ensure his availability following the break. Safe to say, then, that the latest news stemming from Catalunya’s capital will come as a blow for club and player alike. As per a statement across Barcelona’s social media channels on Friday, Christensen has emerged as a late doubt to face Villarreal on Sunday: ‘First team player Andreas Christensen has slight discomfort in his left calf. He is doubtful for the next game. His recovery time will depend on how the discomfort develops.’ MEDICAL NEWS First team player Andreas Christensen has slight discomfort in his left calf. He is doubtful for the next game. His recovery time will depend on how the discomfort develops. pic.twitter.com/DXEKeBPuyC Conor Laird – GSFN
summary_en: Barcelona confirmed defender Andreas Christensen has a new minor issue shortly after returning from a long layoff.

title: Official | Fulham goalkeeper Benjamin Lecomte sustains season-ending Achilles injury
snippet: Fulham FC goalkeeper Benjamin Lecomte (35) has sustained a season-ending Achilles injury, as revealed by Cottagers head coach Alvaro Arbeloa on Friday. The French goalkeeper joined Fulham FC on a…
body: Fulham FC goalkeeper Benjamin Lecomte (35) has sustained a season-ending Achilles injury, as revealed by Cottagers head coach Alvaro Arbeloa on Friday. The French goalkeeper joined Fulham FC on a two-year deal in July 2025. He has signed a one-year extension in September. Lecomte is Bernd Leno’s understudy at Fulham. The former Monaco and Montpellier goalie featured ten times for the West London side. Lecomte sustained a serious injury during a behind-closed-doors game during this month’s international break. “ Unfortunately, Lecomte broke his Achilles tendon, so he will be out, I think for the rest of the season “, Arbelo said. “ We are sorry for him because he’s very important. It is very sad news. ” Fulham play Manchester City away on Saturday for Matchday 11 of the Premier League. GFFN | Bastien Cheval
summary_en: Fulham goalkeeper Benjamin Lecomte ruptured his Achilles tendon and is likely out for the season.
